remarks: Welcome to this stunning modern farmhouse, a perfect blend of timeless charm and contemporary comfort. Nestled on a peaceful cul-de-sac in Wilton, this 4-bedroom, 3-full-bath home offers an ideal retreat surrounded by serene natural beauty. Step inside to discover soaring ceilings and an open floor plan that seamlessly connects the living, dining, and kitchen spaces-perfect for everyday living and effortless entertaining. Oversized windows flood the home with incredible natural sunlight, enhancing the warm, inviting ambiance throughout. The thoughtfully designed layout features a luxurious primary suite complete with a walk-in closet and spa-like bath, plus three spacious additional bedrooms and beautifully appointed full baths. A versatile bonus room on the second floor offers space for indoor play for those rainy summer days. Set on a level property, the home includes a covered patio with outdoor TV and an exceptionally private, flat backyard-ideal for entertaining, gardening or play. Located just minutes from both Wilton Center and Main Street Ridgefield, you'll enjoy the best of both towns with boutique shopping, dining, top-rated schools, and easy commuter access. Experience exceptional modern farmhouse living in a truly picturesque and peaceful setting. Available from mid June through Mid August.
